entities.summary: Mohsen Hussain Al-Duhaylib is a Saudi Arabian weightlifter who competes in the 69 kg category. He placed sixteenth at the 2016 Summer Olympics, and also competed in the similar weight category at the 2014 and 2015 World Weightlifting Championships.
